chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: Fate Marable's band and David Jones's help for Louis Armstrong
summary: David Jones was a reading musician on C-melody sax, trumpet and mellophone who spent hours helping Louis with his parts in Fate's band.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So they had Fate's band. Everybody looked at Fate Marable with awe, because he played that calliope on that boat, and he had a helluva band. That's the band that Louis Armstrong got his finishing touches [tetches], under the tutelage of David Jones. David Jones was a great reading musician. He helped Louis with his parts. He spent hours with Louis.
What did he play? Trumpet, too?
Saxophone. He played [C-melody] saxophone, trumpet, cornet. He played mellophone. He was a great mellophone player.
